Pick up at 1330 hrs (01:30 pm) - 1430 hrs (02:30 pm), from the hotel's lobby, depending on your hotel

We will take you to
 Uluwatu Temple
, famous for its panoramic views of the ocean and is especially
renowned for its stunning sunset.
At Uluwatu Temple, you will be also viewing 
The Kecak dance, 
 a traditional Balinese performance
known for its distinctive use of human voices instead of musical instruments.
Dozens of performers chant "cak-cak-cak" in unison, creating a captivating harmony that supports the
dance.
Originating in the 1930s, Kecak combines elements of the Sanghyang trance ritual and Balinese dance
to depict stories from the Hindu epic, the Ramayana, focusing on the tale of Prince Rama and his quest
to rescue his wife Sita from the demon king Ravana. Performed in open-air settings, such as the
famous Uluwatu Temple at sunset, the Kecak dance offers a profound cultural and visual experience,
highlighting the artistic and spiritual traditions of Bali.
After the tour, we will drop you back to the hotel for good rest.

, a famous landmark in Bali.
It is known for its traditional Balinese architecture and picturesque setting, often surrounded by lush
greenery and mountains. The gate is similar like Lempuyang , but less crowded, and it is a popular spot

typical in Balinese temples and palaces, symbolizing the cosmic mountain that separates the earthly
realm from the spiritual world. The gate is part of the Handara Golf & Resort Bali, situated in the
highlands of Bedugul, and serves as an iconic entrance to this scenic area.

 Uluwatu Temple
, famous for its panoramic views of the ocean and is especially
renowned for its stunning sunset.
At Uluwatu Temple, you will be also viewing 
The Kecak dance, 
 a traditional Balinese performance
known for its distinctive use of human voices instead of musical instruments.
Dozens of performers chant "cak-cak-cak" in unison, creating a captivating harmony that supports the
dance.
Originating in the 1930s, Kecak combines elements of the Sanghyang trance ritual and Balinese dance
to depict stories from the Hindu epic, the Ramayana, focusing on the tale of Prince Rama and his quest
to rescue his wife Sita from the demon king Ravana. Performed in open-air settings, such as the
famous Uluwatu Temple at sunset, the Kecak dance offers a profound cultural and visual experience,
highlighting the artistic and spiritual traditions of Bali. 
After the tour, we will drop you back to the hotel
for good rest.

Cat Village (Pvt Tour With Guide)
Sapa
 
(Wednesday, 11 November 2026)
 
Arrival at Hanoi airport then transfers to the Sapa hotel
13:30: Our tour guide will meet you in the hotel lobby and we will start our tour for Cat Cat village.
14:00: You start trekking to Cat Cat village which is occupied by the Black H’mong tribe. Here, you can
see the hydroelectric power station which was built by the French in the twentieth century. You will
experience the tribal way of life of ethnic minorities while enjoying wonderful views of the terraced rice
paddy fields and the waterfall in Cat Cat village.
17:00: We will leave from Cat Cat village and drop you back to the hotel.
Overnight in Sapa.
Day 1
Fansipan Legend + Glass Bridge (Pvt Tour With Guide) (B)
Sapa
 
(Thursday, 12 November 2026)
 
08:00: After breakfast, transfer to Fansipan cable car station. Lying on an altitude of 3,143m above sea
level, the peak of Fansipan is dubbed the “Roof of Indochina ''. Sun, clouds, wind and mountain seem
to consist of a harmonious and colourful chorus. Gazing down the fairy scenery at sunrise as well as
sunset would always be an unbeatable experience for those who love nature.
(Tour includes cable car ticket and Muong Hoa Mountain Funicular ticket).
Next, we will go to Sapa Glass Bridge which is located at O Quy Ho pass, it is about 17 kms from Sapa
town center.
Arrive Rong May Glass Bridge, you will be directed to the elevator area in the 70-meter-long mountain
tunnel after getting a ticket to see the glass bridge. As soon as you enter the transparent elevator, you
will be able to see the complete panorama of O Quy Ho Pass, the Northwest mountains and forests
that stretch below.
Adventure games are self-paid if you choose to participate in such as: Zipline, Bungee jumping,
Paragliding, Adventure suspension bridge.
16:00: Back to the hotel.
Overnight in Sapa 
Day 2
Sapa To Hanoi (Pvt Transfers Without Guide) + Half Day City Tour
(Pvt Tour With Guide) (B)
Hanoi
 
(Friday, 13 November 2026)
 
After breakfast transfers to the Hanoi hotel
13:00: We will pick you up from your hotel for a half day city tour.
14:00: Continue to visit the Temple of Literature – the first university of Vietnam. The Temple of
Literature is a stunning example of traditional Vietnamese architecture and culture. Founded in 1070, it
was originally established to honor Confucius and serve as a center for education. The complex is
characterized by its beautiful courtyards, well-manicured gardens, and ornate wooden structures. The
entrance features a majestic gate leading to five courtyards, each increasingly significant. Notable
highlights include the main temple, which houses statues of Confucius and his disciples, and the stone
turtles bearing inscriptions that commemorate the scholars who excelled in the imperial examinations.
Next we will visit Tran Quoc Pagoda located on Golden Fish Island in West Lake, it is the oldest
pagoda in Hanoi built in the 6th century.
Next we will go to Ngoc Son Temple located in Hoan Kiem lake.
Meaning 'Temple of the Jade Mountain', Hanoi's most visited temple sits on a small island in the
northern part of Hoan Kiem Lake, connected to the lakeshore by an elegant scarlet bridge (called Cau
The Huc), constructed in classical Vietnamese style. The temple is dedicated to General Tran Hung
Dao (who defeated the Mongols in the 13th century), La To (patron saint of physicians) and the scholar
Van Xuong.
16:30: Tour finishes. Back to hotel
Optional Tour: 1 Hour Cyclo tour & Water Puppet Show. If any guest wants any optional tour extra cost
will be paid directly to the tour guide. 
Day 3
Ninh Binh Tour, Hoa Lu + Tam Coc (Pvt Tour With Guide) (B)
Da Nang
 
(Saturday, 14 November 2026)
 
08:00: We will pick up guests from hotels and leave for the Ninh Binh day tour.
10:30: After arriving in Ninh Binh province, the guide takes you to visit Hoa Lu – the Ancient Royal
capital of VietNam. We will visit Dinh king temple and Le king temple, in the 10th century, finding out
the heroic histories of these two Kings in the Chinese Wars. After that, we went to Tam Coc (10 km far
from Hoa Lu).
12:00: Have lunch at a restaurant. (self-paid)
After lunch you will get on bamboo boat – rowed by the local people – in Hoang Long River to visit Tam
Coc (three caves) on the way. You pass through three enormous caves that provide a brief respite from
the intense summer sun. It takes approximately two hours to go up and down the river and along the
way, you witness local fisherfolk, village life along the river and, of course, the striking limestone karst
formations that Tam Coc is famous for.
16:00: Get in the car and go back to Hanoi.
18:00: We arrive in Hanoi and drop off guests at their hotel.
Overnight in Hanoi.

(Pvt Tour With Guide) (B)
Da Nang
 
(Sunday, 15 November 2026)
 
After breakfast transfers to the Hanoi airport for departure
Arrival at Da Nang airport then transfers to the hotel
13:30: We will pick up guests from their hotel and leave for Marble Mountain.
Marble Mountains is a natural masterpiece bestowed to the land of Da Nang. With the harmonious
beauty of the ecological area and the spiritual and cultural life.
14:45: Transfer to Cam Thanh village meet local fishermen and experience their daily life.
15:30: Take a bamboo basket boat on the Cam Thanh water coconut forest and have a brief
introduction to the history there.
16:00: Join local fishermen on the river and enjoy the hands-on experience of round net and cast net
fishing.
Learn to paddle the unique Vietnamese bamboo basket boat and join in a basket boat race.
Explore the now peaceful coconut waterways of a past war.
16:30: We will leave for Hoi An city and start our city tour.
Tour guides will take visitors to visit the Japanese Covered Bridge built in the early 17th century, it can
be said that this is the most famous spot in Hoi An. If you pay attention, you can immediately recognize
that the symbol on the 20,000 VND bill is this famous Covered Bridge, a very unique and ancient point
of Hoi An.
Visitors will move to the next ancient house attractions in the Hoi An 1-day tour such as: Cantonese
Assembly Hall, Fujian Assembly Hall, Trieu Chau, Tan Ky ancient house, Phung Hung ancient house.
Walking around the lantern street, the Toc church allows visitors to check in the photos of a lifetime
and help you discover all the ancient beauty of Hoi An.
NOTE: Lantern boat trip on Thu Bon River is included in the package.
20:00: We will leave from Hoi An and transfer guests to their hotel in Da Nang.

Cat Village (Pvt Tour With Guide)
Sapa
 
(Wednesday, 11 November 2026)
 
Arrival at Hanoi airport then transfers to the Sapa hotel
13:30: Our tour guide will meet you in the hotel lobby and we will start our tour for Cat Cat village.
14:00: You start trekking to Cat Cat village which is occupied by the Black H’mong tribe. Here, you can
see the hydroelectric power station which was built by the French in the twentieth century. You will
experience the tribal way of life of ethnic minorities while enjoying wonderful views of the terraced rice
paddy fields and the waterfall in Cat Cat village.
17:00: We will leave from Cat Cat village and drop you back to the hotel.
Overnight in Sapa.
Day 1
Fansipan Legend + Glass Bridge (Pvt Tour With Guide) (B)
Sapa
 
(Thursday, 12 November 2026)
 
08:00: After breakfast, transfer to Fansipan cable car station. Lying on an altitude of 3,143m above sea
level, the peak of Fansipan is dubbed the “Roof of Indochina ''. Sun, clouds, wind and mountain seem
to consist of a harmonious and colourful chorus. Gazing down the fairy scenery at sunrise as well as
sunset would always be an unbeatable experience for those who love nature.
(Tour includes cable car ticket and Muong Hoa Mountain Funicular ticket).
Next, we will go to Sapa Glass Bridge which is located at O Quy Ho pass, it is about 17 kms from Sapa
town center.
Arrive Rong May Glass Bridge, you will be directed to the elevator area in the 70-meter-long mountain
tunnel after getting a ticket to see the glass bridge. As soon as you enter the transparent elevator, you
will be able to see the complete panorama of O Quy Ho Pass, the Northwest mountains and forests
that stretch below.
Adventure games are self-paid if you choose to participate in such as: Zipline, Bungee jumping,
Paragliding, Adventure suspension bridge.
16:00: Back to the hotel.
Overnight in Sapa 
Day 2
Sapa To Hanoi (Pvt Transfers Without Guide) + Half Day City Tour
(Pvt Tour With Guide) (B)
Hanoi
 
(Friday, 13 November 2026)
 
After breakfast transfers to the Hanoi hotel
13:00: We will pick you up from your hotel for a half day city tour.
14:00: Continue to visit the Temple of Literature – the first university of Vietnam. The Temple of
Literature is a stunning example of traditional Vietnamese architecture and culture. Founded in 1070, it
was originally established to honor Confucius and serve as a center for education. The complex is
characterized by its beautiful courtyards, well-manicured gardens, and ornate wooden structures. The
entrance features a majestic gate leading to five courtyards, each increasingly significant. Notable
highlights include the main temple, which houses statues of Confucius and his disciples, and the stone
turtles bearing inscriptions that commemorate the scholars who excelled in the imperial examinations.
Next we will visit Tran Quoc Pagoda located on Golden Fish Island in West Lake, it is the oldest
pagoda in Hanoi built in the 6th century.
Next we will go to Ngoc Son Temple located in Hoan Kiem lake.
Meaning 'Temple of the Jade Mountain', Hanoi's most visited temple sits on a small island in the
northern part of Hoan Kiem Lake, connected to the lakeshore by an elegant scarlet bridge (called Cau
The Huc), constructed in classical Vietnamese style. The temple is dedicated to General Tran Hung
Dao (who defeated the Mongols in the 13th century), La To (patron saint of physicians) and the scholar
Van Xuong.
16:30: Tour finishes. Back to hotel
Optional Tour: 1 Hour Cyclo tour & Water Puppet Show. If any guest wants any optional tour extra cost
will be paid directly to the tour guide.

Ninh Binh Tour, Hoa Lu + Tam Coc (Pvt Tour With Guide) (B)
Da Nang
 
(Saturday, 14 November 2026)
 
08:00: We will pick up guests from hotels and leave for the Ninh Binh day tour.
10:30: After arriving in Ninh Binh province, the guide takes you to visit Hoa Lu – the Ancient Royal
capital of VietNam. We will visit Dinh king temple and Le king temple, in the 10th century, finding out
the heroic histories of these two Kings in the Chinese Wars. After that, we went to Tam Coc (10 km far
from Hoa Lu).
12:00: Have lunch at a restaurant. (self-paid)
After lunch you will get on bamboo boat – rowed by the local people – in Hoang Long River to visit Tam
Coc (three caves) on the way. You pass through three enormous caves that provide a brief respite from
the intense summer sun. It takes approximately two hours to go up and down the river and along the
way, you witness local fisherfolk, village life along the river and, of course, the striking limestone karst
formations that Tam Coc is famous for.
16:00: Get in the car and go back to Hanoi.
18:00: We arrive in Hanoi and drop off guests at their hotel.
Overnight in Hanoi.

Marble Mountains is a natural masterpiece bestowed to the land of Da Nang. With the harmonious
beauty of the ecological area and the spiritual and cultural life.
14:45: Transfer to Cam Thanh village meet local fishermen and experience their daily life.
15:30: Take a bamboo basket boat on the Cam Thanh water coconut forest and have a brief

fishing.
Learn to paddle the unique Vietnamese bamboo basket boat and join in a basket boat race.
Explore the now peaceful coconut waterways of a past war.

Tour guides will take visitors to visit the Japanese Covered Bridge built in the early 17th century, it can

that the symbol on the 20,000 VND bill is this famous Covered Bridge, a very unique and ancient point
